title: The half step
summary: The smallest move on the keyboard: from one key to the very next.

steps.title: Half step
steps.body:
A **half step** is the move from one key to the very next key, with nothing in between. It can be white to black, black to white, or even white to white.

**Why it matters:** The half step is the ruler of music: every distance between notes is measured by counting half steps. When a band mate says "take it up a half step", they want the whole song one key higher.

steps.title: Two white keys a half step apart
steps.body:
There is no black key between E and F, or between B and C, so those white keys are only a half step apart.

**Why it matters:** these two spots are why the white keys are not evenly spaced, and they shape every tune you play on white keys.

steps.title: Half steps from C
steps.body: Each lit key is a half step above the one before it.

items.prompt: Play C4, then go up a half step.
Play E4, then go up a half step.
Play D4, then go down a half step.
Start on C and play every key going up, a half step at a time, until you reach the next C.

steps.title: Walk in half steps
steps.body: Pick any key and walk up and down one half step at a time. Listen to how small and tight each step sounds.

items.prompt: Play B4, then go up a half step.
Play F4, then go down a half step.
Pick any key and go up a half step.
